end.summary:
Discussed where earthworms live and how to observe soil animals safely.
Pihu mentioned seeing an earthworm in garden mud.
Questions included whether earthworms loosen soil and help plants.
Teach-back was not passed; lesson ended before understanding was checked.
end.parentNote: Asha practised observing animals in soil and asking how earthworms may affect soil. Pihu shared an observation from the garden and considered looking under leaves without touching. The idea that earthworms are dirty and harm soil was raised, but it was not checked or corrected before the lesson ended. At home, look at a picture or safe video of an earthworm and ask Pihu to share one place it lives and one way to observe it safely.
